---
description: Turn a development request into a ready repository ticket without implementing it.
agent: researcher
---

Read `AGENTS.md`, `tickets/README.md`, the ticket template and relevant product context. Convert the request into one bounded outcome with measurable acceptance criteria, explicit non-goals, dependencies, risk and a minimal context manifest. Put uncertain external claims under research tasks instead of presenting them as facts. Create the ticket in `tickets/ready/` only when it is actionable; otherwise place it in `tickets/backlog/` and state what blocks readiness. Do not implement code.
